I don’t have real‑time market data built into this environment, so I can’t give you the exact price of Bitcoin right now.  
If you need the current price, you can check a reliable financial data source such as:

* **CoinMarketCap** (https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/bitcoin/)
* **CoinGecko** (https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin)
* **Yahoo Finance** (https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BTC-USD/)
* **Binance** or other major exchanges’ APIs

These sites update the price every few seconds/minutes. If you’d like, I can show you how to pull the price programmatically using a public API (e.g., CoinGecko’s free endpoint). Just let me know!
